## Overview

For this project, We will use the documents within the ham/spam dataset located at https://spamassassin.apache.org/old/publiccorpus/ . Using these documents, we will use a portion of the documents to create a decision tree data model. In order to create the decision tree data model, we will look at packages such as `rpart` that deal with Recursive Partitioning and Regression Trees. Once the decision tree data model is created, we will work on testing it against the portion of documents that were not used in the initial creation of the decision tree data model. Through testing, we may make improvements to the decision tree data model and then draw final conclusions from that.
